binary-search.problem: Find the index of a target value in a sorted array.

linear-search-con-centinela.problem: Find a target by scanning the array sequentially.

quicksort.problem: Sort an array using divide-and-conquer partitioning.

mergesort.problem: Sort an array by recursively merging sorted halves.

quickselect.problem: Find the k-th smallest element in expected linear time.

counting-sort.problem: Sort integers in a bounded range by counting occurrences.

heapsort.problem: Sort an array using a binary heap.

bfs.problem: Traverse a graph level by level from a start node.

dfs.problem: Explore a graph deeply before backtracking.

dijkstra.problem: Compute shortest paths from a source in a weighted graph.

prim.problem: Build a minimum spanning tree by growing from a start node.

kruskal.problem: Build an MST by adding lightest edges that avoid cycles.

bellman-ford.problem: Shortest paths with negative edge weights (no negative cycles).

orden-topologico.problem: Linear ordering of a DAG respecting all edges.

union-find-disjoint-set-union.problem: Maintain disjoint sets with near-constant union/find.
